proof_mechanisms: 1. Evaluate the base cubic x0^3/36 + x0^2/4 + 11*x0/6 at each training point
2. Compute residual (expected - base) and check if residuals have period 6
3. Fit the per-residue-class offsets to match training data exactly
claim.statement: Parent_2 used Ehrhart quasi-polynomials with period-2 corrections but had large errors. Parent_4 used a cubic. This synthesis uses a cubic backbone with period-6 (lcm of 2,3) quasi-polynomial corrections, a common structure in partition enumeration problems (e.g., counting partitions into parts of size 1,2,3).
